Plants of the World Online account: Lavandula × alportelensis P.Silva, Fontes & Myre.

The native range of this hybrid is S. Portugal. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is L. stoechas subsp. luisieri × L. viridis.
